front:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
संन्यासस्य महाबाहो तत्त्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम् ।
त्यागस्य च हृषीकेश पृथक्केशिनिषूदन ॥१८.१॥
back: Arjuna asks Krishna to explain separately the true nature of renunciation (sannyasa) and relinquishment (tyaga).
note: Verse 18.1 · Romanized reading: arjuna uvāca . / saṃnyāsasya mahābāho tattvamicchāmi veditum . / tyāgasya ca hṛṣīkeśa pṛthakkeśiniṣūdana

front:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः ।
सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं प्राहुस्त्यागं विचक्षणाः ॥१८.२॥
back: The wise call giving up desire-driven actions renunciation; they call letting go of the fruits of actions relinquishment.
note: Verse 18.2 · Romanized reading: śrībhagavānuvāca . / kāmyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ nyāsaṃ saṃnyāsaṃ kavayo viduḥ . / sarvakarmaphalatyāgaṃ prāhustyāgaṃ vicakṣaṇāḥ

front:
त्याज्यं दोषवदित्येके कर्म प्राहुर्मनीषिणः ।
यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यमिति चापरे ॥१८.३॥
back: Some thinkers say action should be abandoned because it contains faults; others say sacrifice, generosity and discipline should never be abandoned.
note: Verse 18.3 · Romanized reading: tyājyaṃ doṣavadityeke karma prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ . / yajñadānatapaḥkarma na tyājyamiti cāpare

front:
निश्चयं शृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम ।
त्यागो हि पुरुषव्याघ्र त्रिविधः सम्प्रकीर्तितः ॥१८.४॥
back: Krishna asks Arjuna to hear his definite teaching: relinquishment is described in three forms.
note: Verse 18.4 · Romanized reading: niścayaṃ śṛṇu me tatra tyāge bharatasattama . / tyāgo hi puruṣavyāghra trividhaḥ samprakīrtitaḥ

front:
यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यं कार्यमेव तत् ।
यज्ञो दानं तपश्चैव पावनानि मनीषिणाम् ॥१८.५॥
back: Acts of sacrifice, charity and disciplined practice should be performed, for they help purify the wise.
note: Verse 18.5 · Romanized reading: yajñadānatapaḥkarma na tyājyaṃ kāryameva tat . / yajño dānaṃ tapaścaiva pāvanāni manīṣiṇām

front:
एतान्यपि तु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलानि च ।
कर्तव्यानीति मे पार्थ निश्चितं मतमुत्तमम् ॥१८.६॥
back: Even these good acts must be done without attachment or expectation of reward. That is Krishna's considered view.
note: Verse 18.6 · Romanized reading: etānyapi tu karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā phalāni ca . / kartavyānīti me pārtha niścitaṃ matamuttamam

front:
नियतस्य तु संन्यासः कर्मणो नोपपद्यते ।
मोहात्तस्य परित्यागस्तामसः परिकीर्तितः ॥१८.७॥
back: Abandoning one's prescribed responsibility out of confusion is called tamasic relinquishment.
note: Verse 18.7 · Romanized reading: niyatasya tu saṃnyāsaḥ karmaṇo nopapadyate . / mohāttasya parityāgastāmasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ

front:
दुःखमित्येव यत्कर्म कायक्लेशभयात्त्यजेत् ।
स कृत्वा राजसं त्यागं नैव त्यागफलं लभेत् ॥१८.८॥
back: Leaving a task merely because it is painful or physically difficult is rajasic relinquishment, which brings no true fruit of renunciation.
note: Verse 18.8 · Romanized reading: duḥkhamityeva yatkarma kāyakleśabhayāttyajet . / sa kṛtvā rājasaṃ tyāgaṃ naiva tyāgaphalaṃ labhet

front:
कार्यमित्येव यत्कर्म नियतं क्रियतेऽर्जुन ।
सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलं चैव स त्यागः सात्त्विको मतः ॥१८.९॥
back: Doing one's duty because it ought to be done, while giving up attachment and expectation of reward, is sattvic relinquishment.
note: Verse 18.9 · Romanized reading: kāryamityeva yatkarma niyataṃ kriyate.arjuna . / saṅgaṃ tyaktvā phalaṃ caiva sa tyāgaḥ sāttviko mataḥ

front:
न द्वेष्ट्यकुशलं कर्म कुशले नानुषज्जते ।
त्यागी सत्त्वसमाविष्टो मेधावी छिन्नसंशयः ॥१८.१०॥
back: A wise and clear-minded renouncer neither hates difficult work nor clings to pleasant work.
note: Verse 18.10 · Romanized reading: na dveṣṭyakuśalaṃ karma kuśale nānuṣajjate . / tyāgī sattvasamāviṣṭo medhāvī chinnasaṃśayaḥ

front:
न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः ।
यस्तु कर्मफलत्यागी स त्यागीत्यभिधीयते ॥१८.११॥
back: No embodied person can cease all action; the true renouncer gives up attachment to its fruits.
note: Verse 18.11 · Romanized reading: na hi dehabhṛtā śakyaṃ tyaktuṃ karmāṇyaśeṣataḥ . / yastu karmaphalatyāgī sa tyāgītyabhidhīyate

front:
अनिष्टमिष्टं मिश्रं च त्रिविधं कर्मणः फलम् ।
भवत्यत्यागिनां प्रेत्य न तु संन्यासिनां क्वचित् ॥१८.१२॥
back: For those attached to results, action yields pleasant, unpleasant or mixed outcomes; the true renouncer is not bound by them.
note: Verse 18.12 · Romanized reading: aniṣṭamiṣṭaṃ miśraṃ ca trividhaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam . / bhavatyatyāgināṃ pretya na tu saṃnyāsināṃ kvacit

front:
पञ्चैतानि महाबाहो कारणानि निबोध मे ।
साङ्ख्ये कृतान्ते प्रोक्तानि सिद्धये सर्वकर्मणाम् ॥१८.१३॥
back: Krishna introduces five causes that contribute to the accomplishment of every action.
note: Verse 18.13 · Romanized reading: pañcaitāni mahābāho kāraṇāni nibodha me . / sāṅkhye kṛtānte proktāni siddhaye sarvakarmaṇām

front:
अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम् ।
विविधाश्च पृथक्चेष्टा दैवं चैवात्र पञ्चमम् ॥१८.१४॥
back: The five factors are the body or setting, the agent, the instruments, the various efforts and the divine factor.
note: Verse 18.14 · Romanized reading: adhiṣṭhānaṃ tathā kartā karaṇaṃ ca pṛthagvidham . / vividhāśca pṛthakceṣṭā daivaṃ caivātra pañcamam

front:
शरीरवाङ्मनोभिर्यत्कर्म प्रारभते नरः ।
न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चैते तस्य हेतवः ॥१८.१५॥
back: Whatever a person does through body, speech or mind—right or wrong—arises through these five factors.
note: Verse 18.15 · Romanized reading: śarīravāṅmanobhiryatkarma prārabhate naraḥ . / nyāyyaṃ vā viparītaṃ vā pañcaite tasya hetavaḥ

front:
तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः ।
पश्यत्यकृतबुद्धित्वान्न स पश्यति दुर्मतिः ॥१८.१६॥
back: One who imagines the self alone to be the doer, without considering these factors, does not see clearly.
note: Verse 18.16 · Romanized reading: tatraivaṃ sati kartāramātmānaṃ kevalaṃ tu yaḥ . / paśyatyakṛtabuddhitvānna sa paśyati durmatiḥ

front:
यस्य नाहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते ।
हत्वाऽपि स इमाँल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते ॥१८.१७॥
back: One free from egoistic identification, whose understanding is unstained, is not bound by action even amid battle.
note: Verse 18.17 · Romanized reading: yasya nāhaṃkṛto bhāvo buddhiryasya na lipyate . / hatvā.api sa imā.Nllokānna hanti na nibadhyate

front:
ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं परिज्ञाता त्रिविधा कर्मचोदना ।
करणं कर्म कर्तेति त्रिविधः कर्मसंग्रहः ॥१८.१८॥
back: Knowledge, the object known and the knower prompt action; instruments, action and the agent form its working elements.
note: Verse 18.18 · Romanized reading: jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ parijñātā trividhā karmacodanā . / karaṇaṃ karma karteti trividhaḥ karmasaṃgrahaḥ

front:
ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ताच त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः ।
प्रोच्यते गुणसङ्ख्याने यथावच्छृणु तान्यपि ॥१८.१९॥
back: Knowledge, action and the doer are each described as threefold according to the qualities of nature.
note: Verse 18.19 · Romanized reading: jñānaṃ karma ca kartāca tridhaiva guṇabhedataḥ . / procyate guṇasaṅkhyāne yathāvacchṛṇu tānyapi

front:
सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावमव्ययमीक्षते ।
अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम् ॥१८.२०॥
back: Sattvic knowledge perceives one undivided, imperishable reality present in all the many beings.
note: Verse 18.20 · Romanized reading: sarvabhūteṣu yenaikaṃ bhāvamavyayamīkṣate . / avibhaktaṃ vibhakteṣu tajjñānaṃ viddhi sāttvikam

front:
पृथक्त्वेन तु यज्ज्ञानं नानाभावान्पृथग्विधान् ।
वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि राजसम् ॥१८.२१॥
back: Rajasic knowledge sees beings as separate and fundamentally diverse.
note: Verse 18.21 · Romanized reading: pṛthaktvena tu yajjñānaṃ nānābhāvānpṛthagvidhān . / vetti sarveṣu bhūteṣu tajjñānaṃ viddhi rājasam

front:
यत्तु कृत्स्नवदेकस्मिन्कार्ये सक्तमहैतुकम् ।
अतत्त्वार्थवदल्पं च तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ॥१८.२२॥
back: Tamasic knowledge clings narrowly to one fragment as though it were the whole, without sound reasoning or truth.
note: Verse 18.22 · Romanized reading: yattu kṛtsnavadekasminkārye saktamahaitukam . / atattvārthavadalpaṃ ca tattāmasamudāhṛtam

front:
नियतं सङ्गरहितमरागद्वेषतः कृतम् ।
अफलप्रेप्सुना कर्म यत्तत्सात्त्विकमुच्यते ॥१८.२३॥
back: Sattvic action is a duty performed without attachment, attraction, aversion or craving for reward.
note: Verse 18.23 · Romanized reading: niyataṃ saṅgarahitamarāgadveṣataḥ kṛtam . / aphalaprepsunā karma yattatsāttvikamucyate

front:
यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहंकारेण वा पुनः ।
क्रियते बहुलायासं तद्राजसमुदाहृतम् ॥१८.२४॥
back: Rajasic action is driven by desire or ego and performed with excessive strain.
note: Verse 18.24 · Romanized reading: yattu kāmepsunā karma sāhaṃkāreṇa vā punaḥ . / kriyate bahulāyāsaṃ tadrājasamudāhṛtam

front:
अनुबन्धं क्षयं हिंसामनपेक्ष्य च पौरुषम् ।
मोहादारभ्यते कर्म यत्तत्तामसमुच्यते ॥१८.२५॥
back: Tamasic action begins in delusion, ignoring consequences, loss, harm to others and one's own ability.
note: Verse 18.25 · Romanized reading: anubandhaṃ kṣayaṃ hiṃsāmanapekṣya ca pauruṣam . / mohādārabhyate karma yattattāmasamucyate

front:
मुक्तसङ्गोऽनहंवादी धृत्युत्साहसमन्वितः ।
सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योर्निर्विकारः कर्ता सात्त्विक उच्यते ॥१८.२६॥
back: A sattvic doer is unattached and humble, energetic and steady, remaining balanced in success and failure.
note: Verse 18.26 · Romanized reading: muktasaṅgo.anahaṃvādī dhṛtyutsāhasamanvitaḥ . / siddhyasiddhyornirvikāraḥ kartā sāttvika ucyate

front:
रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुर्लुब्धो हिंसात्मकोऽशुचिः ।
हर्षशोकान्वितः कर्ता राजसः परिकीर्तितः ॥१८.२७॥
back: A rajasic doer seeks rewards, is greedy or harmful, impure and swayed by joy and sorrow.
note: Verse 18.27 · Romanized reading: rāgī karmaphalaprepsurlubdho hiṃsātmako.aśuciḥ . / harṣaśokānvitaḥ kartā rājasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ

front:
अयुक्तः प्राकृतः स्तब्धः शठो नैष्कृतिकोऽलसः ।
विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते ॥१८.२८॥
back: A tamasic doer is undisciplined, stubborn, deceitful, malicious, lazy, despondent and prone to delay.
note: Verse 18.28 · Romanized reading: ayuktaḥ prākṛtaḥ stabdhaḥ śaṭho naiṣkṛtiko.alasaḥ . / viṣādī dīrghasūtrī ca kartā tāmasa ucyate

front:
बुद्धेर्भेदं धृतेश्चैव गुणतस्त्रिविधं शृणु ।
प्रोच्यमानमशेषेण पृथक्त्वेन धनञ्जय ॥१८.२९॥
back: Krishna now explains the three kinds of understanding and the three kinds of steadfastness.
note: Verse 18.29 · Romanized reading: buddherbhedaṃ dhṛteścaiva guṇatastrividhaṃ śṛṇu . / procyamānamaśeṣeṇa pṛthaktvena dhanañjaya

front:
प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये ।
बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी ॥१८.३०॥
back: Sattvic understanding distinguishes right action from wrong, what to pursue from what to avoid, fear from safety and bondage from freedom.
note: Verse 18.30 · Romanized reading: pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca kāryākārye bhayābhaye . / bandhaṃ mokṣaṃ ca yā vetti buddhiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī

front:
यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्यं चाकार्यमेव च ।
अयथावत्प्रजानाति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ राजसी ॥१८.३१॥
back: Rajasic understanding only imperfectly distinguishes right from wrong and what should from what should not be done.
note: Verse 18.31 · Romanized reading: yayā dharmamadharmaṃ ca kāryaṃ cākāryameva ca . / ayathāvatprajānāti buddhiḥ sā pārtha rājasī

front:
अधर्मं धर्ममिति या मन्यते तमसावृता ।
सर्वार्थान्विपरीतांश्च बुद्धिः सा पार्थ तामसी ॥१८.३२॥
back: Tamasic understanding, clouded by ignorance, mistakes wrong for right and turns judgments upside down.
note: Verse 18.32 · Romanized reading: adharmaṃ dharmamiti yā manyate tamasāvṛtā . / sarvārthānviparītāṃśca buddhiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī

front:
धृत्या यया धारयते मनःप्राणेन्द्रियक्रियाः ।
योगेनाव्यभिचारिण्या धृतिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी ॥१८.३३॥
back: Sattvic steadfastness steadily governs the mind, life energies and senses through disciplined practice.
note: Verse 18.33 · Romanized reading: dhṛtyā yayā dhārayate manaḥprāṇendriyakriyāḥ . / yogenāvyabhicāriṇyā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī

front:
यया तु धर्मकामार्थान्धृत्या धारयतेऽर्जुन ।
प्रसङ्गेन फलाकाङ्क्षी धृतिः सा पार्थ राजसी ॥१८.३४॥
back: Rajasic steadfastness clings to duty, pleasure and prosperity while seeking their rewards.
note: Verse 18.34 · Romanized reading: yayā tu dharmakāmārthāndhṛtyā dhārayate.arjuna . / prasaṅgena phalākāṅkṣī dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha rājasī

front:
यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च ।
न विमुञ्चति दुर्मेधा धृतिः सा पार्थ तामसी ॥१८.३५॥
back: Tamasic steadfastness refuses to release sleep, fear, grief, despair and conceit.
note: Verse 18.35 · Romanized reading: yayā svapnaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ viṣādaṃ madameva ca . / na vimuñcati durmedhā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī

front:
सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं शृणु मे भरतर्षभ ।
अभ्यासाद्रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छति ॥१८.३६॥
back: Krishna invites Arjuna to hear of three forms of happiness, including the kind that grows with practice and ends sorrow.
note: Verse 18.36 · Romanized reading: sukhaṃ tvidānīṃ trividhaṃ śṛṇu me bharatarṣabha . / abhyāsādramate yatra duḥkhāntaṃ ca nigacchati

front:
यत्तदग्रे विषमिव परिणामेऽमृतोपमम् ।
तत्सुखं सात्त्विकं प्रोक्तमात्मबुद्धिप्रसादजम् ॥१८.३७॥
back: Sattvic happiness may feel bitter at first but becomes like nectar, arising from clarity of the self.
note: Verse 18.37 · Romanized reading: yattadagre viṣamiva pariṇāme.amṛtopamam . / tatsukhaṃ sāttvikaṃ proktamātmabuddhiprasādajam

front:
विषयेन्द्रियसंयोगाद्यत्तदग्रेऽमृतोपमम् ।
परिणामे विषमिव तत्सुखं राजसं स्मृतम् ॥१८.३८॥
back: Rajasic happiness from contact between senses and objects seems sweet at first but becomes bitter later.
note: Verse 18.38 · Romanized reading: viṣayendriyasaṃyogādyattadagre.amṛtopamam . / pariṇāme viṣamiva tatsukhaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam

front:
यदग्रे चानुबन्धे च सुखं मोहनमात्मनः ।
निद्रालस्यप्रमादोत्थं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ॥१८.३९॥
back: Tamasic happiness deludes from beginning to end and springs from sleep, laziness and heedlessness.
note: Verse 18.39 · Romanized reading: yadagre cānubandhe ca sukhaṃ mohanamātmanaḥ . / nidrālasyapramādotthaṃ tattāmasamudāhṛtam

front:
न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः ।
सत्त्वं प्रकृतिजैर्मुक्तं यदेभिः स्यात्त्रिभिर्गुणैः ॥१८.४०॥
back: Nothing on earth or among celestial beings is free from the three qualities arising from nature.
note: Verse 18.40 · Romanized reading: na tadasti pṛthivyāṃ vā divi deveṣu vā punaḥ . / sattvaṃ prakṛtijairmuktaṃ yadebhiḥ syāttribhirguṇaiḥ

front:
ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परन्तप ।
कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्वभावप्रभवैर्गुणैः ॥१८.४१॥
back: Krishna describes traditional social duties as differentiated according to qualities and dispositions arising from nature.
note: Verse 18.41 · Romanized reading: brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca parantapa . / karmāṇi pravibhaktāni svabhāvaprabhavairguṇaiḥ

front:
शमो दमस्तपः शौचं क्षान्तिरार्जवमेव च ।
ज्ञानं विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं ब्रह्मकर्म स्वभावजम् ॥१८.४२॥
back: Calmness, self-control, austerity, purity, patience, honesty, learning, insight and faith are qualities of the traditional Brahmin role.
note: Verse 18.42 · Romanized reading: śamo damastapaḥ śaucaṃ kṣāntirārjavameva ca . / jñānaṃ vijñānamāstikyaṃ brahmakarma svabhāvajam

front:
शौर्यं तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्यपलायनम् ।
दानमीश्वरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्वभावजम् ॥१८.४३॥
back: Courage, strength, firmness, skill, steadfastness in battle, generosity and leadership belong to the traditional Kshatriya role.
note: Verse 18.43 · Romanized reading: śauryaṃ tejo dhṛtirdākṣyaṃ yuddhe cāpyapalāyanam . / dānamīśvarabhāvaśca kṣātraṃ karma svabhāvajam

front:
कृषिगौरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैश्यकर्म स्वभावजम् ।
परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि स्वभावजम् ॥१८.४४॥
back: Farming, care of cattle and trade are described as Vaishya duties; service-oriented work as Shudra duty in this traditional framework.
note: Verse 18.44 · Romanized reading: kṛṣigaurakṣyavāṇijyaṃ vaiśyakarma svabhāvajam . / paricaryātmakaṃ karma śūdrasyāpi svabhāvajam

front:
स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः ।
स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धिं यथा विन्दति तच्छृणु ॥१८.४५॥
back: A person devoted to work suited to their nature can attain fulfillment; Krishna explains how.
note: Verse 18.45 · Romanized reading: sve sve karmaṇyabhirataḥ saṃsiddhiṃ labhate naraḥ . / svakarmanirataḥ siddhiṃ yathā vindati tacchṛṇu

front:
यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ।
स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः ॥१८.४६॥
back: By offering one's work in worship to the source from whom beings arise and by whom all is pervaded, one can attain perfection.
note: Verse 18.46 · Romanized reading: yataḥ pravṛttirbhūtānāṃ yena sarvamidaṃ tatam . / svakarmaṇā tamabhyarcya siddhiṃ vindati mānavaḥ

front:
श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात् ।
स्वभावनियतं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम् ॥१८.४७॥
back: Doing one's own duty, though imperfectly, is better than doing another's flawlessly; work rooted in one's nature need not bring guilt.
note: Verse 18.47 · Romanized reading: śreyānsvadharmo viguṇaḥ paradharmātsvanuṣṭhitāt . / svabhāvaniyataṃ karma kurvannāpnoti kilbiṣam

front:
सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत् ।
सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवावृताः ॥१८.४८॥
back: One should not abandon work natural to oneself merely because it has defects; every undertaking has some flaw, just as fire has smoke.
note: Verse 18.48 · Romanized reading: sahajaṃ karma kaunteya sadoṣamapi na tyajet . / sarvārambhā hi doṣeṇa dhūmenāgnirivāvṛtāḥ

front:
असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः ।
नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धिं परमां संन्यासेनाधिगच्छति ॥१८.४९॥
back: Through detachment, mastery of oneself and freedom from craving, one reaches the highest perfection of renunciation.
note: Verse 18.49 · Romanized reading: asaktabuddhiḥ sarvatra jitātmā vigataspṛhaḥ . / naiṣkarmyasiddhiṃ paramāṃ saṃnyāsenādhigacchati

front:
सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे ।
समासेनैव कौन्तेय निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य या परा ॥१८.५०॥
back: Krishna briefly describes how one who has attained perfection may reach Brahman, the highest state of knowledge.
note: Verse 18.50 · Romanized reading: siddhiṃ prāpto yathā brahma tathāpnoti nibodha me . / samāsenaiva kaunteya niṣṭhā jñānasya yā parā

front:
बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्यात्मानं नियम्य च ।
शब्दादीन्विषयांस्त्यक्त्वा रागद्वेषौ व्युदस्य च ॥१८.५१॥
back: With purified understanding and firm self-control, one lets go of sense distractions, attachment and aversion.
note: Verse 18.51 · Romanized reading: buddhyā viśuddhayā yukto dhṛtyātmānaṃ niyamya ca . / śabdādīnviṣayāṃstyaktvā rāgadveṣau vyudasya ca

front:
विविक्तसेवी लघ्वाशी यतवाक्कायमानसः ।
ध्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः ॥१८.५२॥
back: Living simply and moderately, controlling speech, body and mind, one remains devoted to meditation and detachment.
note: Verse 18.52 · Romanized reading: viviktasevī laghvāśī yatavākkāyamānasaḥ . / dhyānayogaparo nityaṃ vairāgyaṃ samupāśritaḥ

front:
अहंकारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम् ।
विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते ॥१८.५३॥
back: Freeing oneself from ego, domination, pride, desire, anger and possessiveness, one becomes peaceful and prepared for realization of Brahman.
note: Verse 18.53 · Romanized reading: ahaṃkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham . / vimucya nirmamaḥ śānto brahmabhūyāya kalpate

front:
ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति ।
समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पराम् ॥१८.५४॥
back: One established in Brahman is serene, neither grieving nor craving, and equal toward all beings; such a person gains supreme devotion.
note: Verse 18.54 · Romanized reading: brahmabhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śocati na kāṅkṣati . / samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu madbhaktiṃ labhate parām

front:
भक्त्या मामभिजानाति यावान्यश्चास्मि तत्त्वतः ।
ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम् ॥१८.५५॥
back: Through devotion one truly knows Krishna's nature and greatness; knowing him in truth, one enters into union with him.
note: Verse 18.55 · Romanized reading: bhaktyā māmabhijānāti yāvānyaścāsmi tattvataḥ . / tato māṃ tattvato jñātvā viśate tadanantaram

front:
सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्व्यपाश्रयः ।
मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम् ॥१८.५६॥
back: Even while carrying out every kind of work, a person who takes refuge in Krishna attains the eternal state through divine grace.
note: Verse 18.56 · Romanized reading: sarvakarmāṇyapi sadā kurvāṇo madvyapāśrayaḥ . / matprasādādavāpnoti śāśvataṃ padamavyayam

front:
चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः ।
बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव ॥१८.५७॥
back: Dedicate all actions to Krishna, regard him as supreme, follow the discipline of understanding and keep the mind centered on him.
note: Verse 18.57 · Romanized reading: cetasā sarvakarmāṇi mayi saṃnyasya matparaḥ . / buddhiyogamupāśritya maccittaḥ satataṃ bhava

front:
मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात्तरिष्यसि ।
अथ चेत्त्वमहंकारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनङ्क्ष्यसि ॥१८.५८॥
back: With the mind fixed on Krishna, one crosses difficulties by grace; stubborn refusal through ego brings ruin.
note: Verse 18.58 · Romanized reading: maccittaḥ sarvadurgāṇi matprasādāttariṣyasi . / atha cettvamahaṃkārānna śroṣyasi vinaṅkṣyasi

front:
यदहंकारमाश्रित्य न योत्स्य इति मन्यसे ।
मिथ्यैष व्यवसायस्ते प्रकृतिस्त्वां नियोक्ष्यति ॥१८.५९॥
back: If Arjuna thinks 'I will not fight' from pride, that resolve is futile; his nature will still move him to act.
note: Verse 18.59 · Romanized reading: yadahaṃkāramāśritya na yotsya iti manyase . / mithyaiṣa vyavasāyaste prakṛtistvāṃ niyokṣyati

front:
स्वभावजेन कौन्तेय निबद्धः स्वेन कर्मणा ।
कर्तुं नेच्छसि यन्मोहात्करिष्यस्यवशोपि तत् ॥१८.६०॥
back: Bound by action rooted in one's own disposition, one may be driven to do even what one presently refuses in confusion.
note: Verse 18.60 · Romanized reading: svabhāvajena kaunteya nibaddhaḥ svena karmaṇā . / kartuṃ necchasi yanmohātkariṣyasyavaśopi tat

front:
ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां हृद्देशेऽर्जुन तिष्ठति ।
भ्रामयन्सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूढानि मायया ॥१८.६१॥
back: The Lord dwells in the hearts of all beings and, through divine power, turns them as though mounted on a machine.
note: Verse 18.61 · Romanized reading: īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ hṛddeśe.arjuna tiṣṭhati . / bhrāmayansarvabhūtāni yantrārūḍhāni māyayā

front:
तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत ।
तत्प्रसादात्परां शान्तिं स्थानं प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम् ॥१८.६२॥
back: Take refuge in that Lord wholeheartedly; through grace one attains deep peace and the eternal abode.
note: Verse 18.62 · Romanized reading: tameva śaraṇaṃ gaccha sarvabhāvena bhārata . / tatprasādātparāṃ śāntiṃ sthānaṃ prāpsyasi śāśvatam

front:
इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया ।
विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु ॥१८.६३॥
back: Krishna has shared profound wisdom and asks Arjuna to reflect on it fully, then act as he chooses.
note: Verse 18.63 · Romanized reading: iti te jñānam ākhyātaṁ guhyād guhyataraṁ mayā / vimṛiśhyaitad aśheṣheṇa yathechchhasi tathā kuru

front:
सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः शृणु मे परमं वचः ।
इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम् ॥१८.६४॥
back: Because Arjuna is dear to him, Krishna offers once more his deepest and most beneficial teaching.
note: Verse 18.64 · Romanized reading: sarvaguhyatamaṃ bhūyaḥ śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ . / iṣṭo.asi me dṛḍhamiti tato vakṣyāmi te hitam

front:
मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु ।
मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे ॥१८.६५॥
back: Keep the mind on Krishna, be devoted, worship and bow to him; Krishna promises that the beloved devotee will come to him.
note: Verse 18.65 · Romanized reading: manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru . / māmevaiṣyasi satyaṃ te pratijāne priyo.asi me

front:
सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज ।
अहं त्वां सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः ॥१८.६६॥
back: Relinquish all other forms of reliance and seek refuge in Krishna alone; he promises release from all wrongdoing and says not to grieve.
note: Verse 18.66 · Romanized reading: sarva-dharmān parityajya mām ekaṁ śharaṇaṁ vraja / ahaṁ tvāṁ sarva-pāpebhyo mokṣhayiṣhyāmi mā śhuchaḥ

front:
इदं ते नातपस्काय नाभक्ताय कदाचन ।
न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति ॥१८.६७॥
back: This teaching should not be shared with those who reject disciplined practice, devotion, listening or who speak maliciously of Krishna.
note: Verse 18.67 · Romanized reading: idaṃ te nātapaskāya nābhaktāya kadācana . / na cāśuśrūṣave vācyaṃ na ca māṃ yo.abhyasūyati

front:
य इदं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति ।
भक्तिं मयि परां कृत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः ॥१८.६८॥
back: Whoever shares this profound teaching among devotees with supreme devotion will surely come to Krishna.
note: Verse 18.68 · Romanized reading: ya idaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ madbhakteṣvabhidhāsyati . / bhaktiṃ mayi parāṃ kṛtvā māmevaiṣyatyasaṃśayaḥ

front:
न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्चिन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः ।
भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि ॥१८.६९॥
back: No one among people renders Krishna a dearer service than one who shares this teaching, nor will anyone be more dear to him.
note: Verse 18.69 · Romanized reading: na ca tasmānmanuṣyeṣu kaścinme priyakṛttamaḥ . / bhavitā na ca me tasmādanyaḥ priyataro bhuvi

front:
अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः ।
ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः ॥१८.७०॥
back: Whoever studies this sacred dialogue between Krishna and Arjuna worships Krishna through the offering of knowledge.
note: Verse 18.70 · Romanized reading: adhyeṣyate ca ya imaṃ dharmyaṃ saṃvādamāvayoḥ . / jñānayajñena tenāhamiṣṭaḥ syāmiti me matiḥ

front:
श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च शृणुयादपि यो नरः ।
सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम् ॥१८.७१॥
back: Even one who listens with faith and without hostility is freed from wrongdoing and reaches the blessed realms of virtuous people.
note: Verse 18.71 · Romanized reading: śraddhāvānanasūyaśca śṛṇuyādapi yo naraḥ . / so.api muktaḥ śubhā.Nllokānprāpnuyātpuṇyakarmaṇām

front:
कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा ।
कच्चिदज्ञानसम्मोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनञ्जय ॥१८.७२॥
back: Krishna asks whether Arjuna listened with full attention and whether his confusion born of ignorance has vanished.
note: Verse 18.72 · Romanized reading: kaccidetacchrutaṃ pārtha tvayaikāgreṇa cetasā . / kaccidajñānasammohaḥ pranaṣṭaste dhanañjaya

front:
नष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत ।
स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव ॥१८.७३॥
back: Arjuna declares that his confusion is gone, understanding restored and doubts removed; he is ready to follow Krishna's instruction.
note: Verse 18.73 · Romanized reading: naṣhṭo mohaḥ smṛitir labdhā tvat-prasādān mayāchyuta / sthito 'smi gata-sandehaḥ kariṣhye vachanaṁ tava

front:
सञ्जय उवाच ।
इत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः ।
संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम् ॥१८.७४॥
back: Sanjaya tells the king that he heard this wondrous, stirring conversation between the great Krishna and Arjuna.
note: Verse 18.74 · Romanized reading: sañjaya uvāca . / ityahaṃ vāsudevasya pārthasya ca mahātmanaḥ . / saṃvādamimamaśrauṣamadbhutaṃ romaharṣaṇam

front:
व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतवानेतद्गुह्यमहं परम् ।
योगं योगेश्वरात्कृष्णात्साक्षात्कथयतः स्वयम् ॥१८.७५॥
back: Through Vyasa's grace, Sanjaya heard Krishna, the master of yoga, personally reveal this supreme teaching.
note: Verse 18.75 · Romanized reading: vyāsaprasādācchrutavānetadguhyamahaṃ param . / yogaṃ yogeśvarātkṛṣṇātsākṣātkathayataḥ svayam

front:
राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम् ।
केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥१८.७६॥
back: Remembering the sacred conversation between Krishna and Arjuna again and again fills Sanjaya with joy.
note: Verse 18.76 · Romanized reading: rājansaṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya saṃvādamimamadbhutam . / keśavārjunayoḥ puṇyaṃ hṛṣyāmi ca muhurmuhuḥ

front:
तच्च संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपमत्यद्भुतं हरेः ।
विस्मयो मे महान् राजन्हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः ॥१८.७७॥
back: Remembering Krishna's astonishing divine form again and again fills Sanjaya with wonder and delight.
note: Verse 18.77 · Romanized reading: tacca saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya rūpamatyadbhutaṃ hareḥ . / vismayo me mahān rājanhṛṣyāmi ca punaḥ punaḥ

front:
यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः ।
तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम ॥१८.७८॥
back: Where Krishna, the Lord of Yoga, and Arjuna, the skilled archer, stand together, Sanjaya expects prosperity, victory, wellbeing and firm righteousness.
note: Verse 18.78 · Romanized reading: yatra yogeśhvaraḥ kṛiṣhṇo yatra pārtho dhanur-dharaḥ / tatra śhrīr vijayo bhūtir dhruvā nītir matir mama
